Raw WS000001 send passes identical param and receiveAck references; no service-specific request/response translation.
Raw WS000002 send passes identical param/receiveAck and returns send promise; destination file path and optional header flags are not translated.

Online typed wrapper passes identical param/receiveAck and resolved response object. Ack envelope is retained; only nested response promise is translated. Offline loginMode2 performs no raw request and resolves JSON '{}' or XML '' with no resultInfo: this is a local no-op,not remote success.
Download typed API passes param/receiveAck and response unchanged,including ack envelope. Unlike general-service typed wrapper,it has no offline shortcut.

Skip canceled,empty VIN/IDs,invalid URL or healthCheckCid undefined/truthy. POST JSON scantoolVersion/domain/language/calibrationId array. Parse failure becomes empty objects; transport rejection resolves; MIR4000000/TGD4000000 rejects revoke; otherwise cache commonResult/apiResult and fault messages.

Only initial required or optional transition with SSC/CID enabled and absent cached production date. POST JSON vin; successful parse caches commonResult/apiResult and calls overwriteProductionDate WITHOUT awaiting its promise. Transport rejection resolves; business revoke rejects; service completion is not stored-data write completion.

Truthy date updates commonInfo immediately,then asynchronously reads StoredDataManager vehicleInfo storedId0/allData=true,sets productionDate,and returns overwirteVehicleInfo promise. Calling service handler does not await this promise. Backend write/hash-refresh semantics belong to persistence_commit.
MIR4000000 or TGD4000000 sets isRunning=false and reports revoke; other business codes do not imply revoke.
POST JSON milInput with session/version/VIN/date/language/userTypeCode/type DataListData/dd. Response JSON is returned to caller; transport/body parse rejection is not a durable upload receipt.

POST JSON milInput type SystemDTC plus status/DTC arrays; systemDtc/selected URL/id and already-executed ECU gates. Only rejection of original PF request is swallowed. Fulfillment JSON.parse failure and MIR4000000 revoke reject through final handler; executed-ECU marker is appended only on resolved path,including swallowed transport rejection.

Await saveSystemDtc before createReturnValue. Catch resolves revoke reason without createReturnValue; other failures reject using reason.resultInfo.code/detailCode. Parse SyntaxError lacks resultInfo,so this catch can itself throw TypeError; it does not turn parsing failure into successful diagnostic continuation.

POST downloadtoCalFile SoftwareID/ID and reqData swNo/fileName/filePath. Require MIR2000000 and no fault. Direct apiResult.URL skips polling; otherwise uppercase SHA256(ID) forms requestDownloadtoCalFileURL ID/HashValue. Errors resolve isShowDl007=true.

Wait1000ms before first request; POST correlation body repeatedly on MIR2020000 or MIR2000000 without URL;15-minute accumulated timer,not wall-clock deadline. This polling body has no isCancel guard. Failure/fault/timeout resolves dialog flag,not an exception to outer workflow.

WS000002 downloads returned URL to timestamp.zip with wire authHeader:true (AuthHeaderRemove: remove Bearer,retain GUID/MSK/Basic),then enumerate all *.zip,extract tmp,move selected calibration/package extensions overwrite=true,delete tmp and ZIP. Each extraction/move/delete failure is swallowed. A false dialog flag is not proof all calibration files were installed; failed ZIP deletion can leave repeated enumeration.
Help uses createHelpInfoUrl and window.open _blank; it is browser navigation,not WS000001/GeneralWebService. No client entitlement or remote receipt inferred.
Resolve country/user-type configuration selection before service consumers; filePath drives getSettingFileInfo. See source-pinned country/userType mapping and per-file public endpoint rows.

Utility wrapper inspects XML statusCode or JSON root/commonResult only for JSON enum (not JSON_UTF-8). Suffix4010002 plus nested commonResult.secureWebService.ssoURL starts secondary login; success replays identical request once,login rejection resolves original response. Second reply is not inspected recursively.
Help concatenates commonInfo.getHelpInfoUrl() and specification/function ID verbatim; no request serialization or native web-service call.
